mission: Delivery speed-up (owner decision 2026-10-15): two delivery lanes with an automatic product-lane classifier, live-state auto-merge arming, merge-window guard, and test hygiene root-cause fixes. Staging only; no collector release, no migration.

impacts.reason: CI policy only, staging PRs: policy-gate runs the base copy of staging_policy.py + product_lane.py (from a base worktree) and exposes the lane; staging-pr-live reads the live PR before joining card-pirate-staging-delivery (PR #123: same-second push and ready_for_review left one run with a stale head and one with a stale draft flag, nothing armed); staging-credential-presence checks a staging Postgres backup under 24 h for a product migration; staging-automerge disarms auto-merge 19:30-20:30 UTC and re-arms the same head, timeout 240 min; delivery skips collector rollout and RAW DDL for product merges and refuses a full delivery whose manifest did not change; backend/worker tests get REQUIRE_POSTGRES=1 and the worker job a Postgres service. No secret, variable, provider or production destination changes.

Read-only delivery tooling: product_lane.py (path + import-graph + migration allowlist classifier, fail closed to DATA), staging_policy.py (PRODUCT result when classified so, otherwise today's mission evaluation unchanged), staging_delivery_scope.py ('product' decision), staging_backup_age.py (read-only Railway backup age, prints no credentials). Not collector runtime inputs (scripts/ is not installed in any image).

Classifier tests in both directions on real Git objects and the real import graph (web/tests/docs/allowlisted API -> PRODUCT; collector input, price/identity/MV/Index, wiring, scripts, workflows, manifest, destructive or disguised migrations -> DATA; fail-closed paths). Temp-dir cleanup race in #120 CI (run 38536722191): throwaway repos disable git auto-maintenance.

Test-only: discovery.test.tsx fired the previous test's dead IntersectionObserver (#120 run 38540558115, 24 vs 48 rows); now waits for the live sentinel observer. AppShell.test.tsx: removed invalid `exact` role option (TS2769).

Test-only (not installed in any image; 0 collector runtime inputs for SNKRDUNK and Yuyu-Tei by scripts/collector_runtime_inputs.py): conftest fails fast when the imported opcg_source_identity differs from the checkout's packages/opcg_source_identity; one pg_url helper builds every API/worker test DB URL from TEST_POSTGRES_URL and fails instead of skipping with REQUIRE_POSTGRES=1.

Two delivery lanes in AUTONOMY_POLICY.md and STAGING_DELIVERY.md (data-lane text unchanged), PRODUCT_LOG.md, and the live market-index-snapshot start command (python -m app.market_index_daily_pipeline, checked read-only 2026-10-15) in operations.md.

impact.deployment_impact: Workflow and test-only change. collector_services is empty and no raw_dependency_migration: 0 collector rollouts, no DDL. API may rebuild with identical runtime code; web redeploys through Vercel Git with test-only changes.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR restores the previous CI policy (mission manifest required for every PR), arming conditions and tests. No data, schema or service configuration to undo.
recovery.trigger: Any product-lane classification of a collector input, price/identity/MV/Index path, workflow, script or manifest; a product merge that rolls out a collector or runs DDL; arming failures on valid PRs; red CI from the new REQUIRE_POSTGRES or identity guard.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change. Railway Postgres daily backups continue.

verification.observation_window: Delivery receipt for this merge with 0 collector rollouts and no RAW DDL; next product-lane PR classified PRODUCT by policy-gate without a manifest and delivered with decision 'product'.
